2609.30009.title: Automated Regulatory Compliance Question Answering in Financial Services with Domain-Adapted Retrieval-Augmented Generation
2609.30009.paper_summary: Financial institutions operate under dense, frequently amended rulebooks, and answering a compliance question correctly requires not only fluency but verifiable grounding in the authoritative text. Large language models are attractive for this task, yet the models that firms can realistically deploy on-premise are compact ones, and compact models hallucinate obligations. We study whether a carefully domain-adapted retrieval-augmented generation pipeline closes that gap. Our retriever is built in three stages on top of LegalBERT: entailment tuning that recasts question--passage matching as premise--hypothesis reconstruction, contrastive tuning with in-batch negatives, and score-level fusion with BM25. Our generator is a compact model (2B--12B parameters) served under 4-bit quantization, either prompted or adapted with retrieval-aware fine-tuning (RAFT) through LoRA. On ObliQA, a question-answering benchmark built from the Abu Dhabi Global Market rulebooks, the staged retriever raises Recall@10 from 0.256 to 0.774 and outperforms BM25 (0.678) and E5-large-v2 (0.758), the strongest general-purpose dense encoder we tested. RAFT-LoRA then improves the composite RePASs answer-quality score for every model we could adapt, with the largest gain on the weakest one. However, the adapted models do not transfer to Australian case-law questions, and a closed-book model that receives no passages at all scores within 0.011 RePASs of the full pipeline while producing answers that cite nothing and misstate obligations. The retrieval gain is therefore measured directly, the generation gain is a gain in RePASs rather than demonstrated grounding, and grounding itself requires an evaluation protocol that RePASs does not provide.
2609.30009.paper_summary_zh: 金融機構在密集且經常修訂的規則手冊下運作，正確回答合規問題不僅需要流利的語言能力，還需要在權威文本中有可驗證的基礎。大型語言模型在這項任務中具有吸引力，然而企業實際上可以部署的本地模型是緊湊型的，而緊湊型模型會產生錯誤的義務。我們研究了一個精心調整的檢索增強生成管道是否能彌補這一差距。我們的檢索器基於 LegalBERT 建立，分為三個階段：前提調整將問題-段落匹配重新構造為前提-假設重建，對比調整使用批內負樣本，以及與 BM25 的分數級融合。我們的生成器是一個緊湊型模型（2B-12B 參數），在 4 位量化下提供，通過 LoRA 進行檢索感知微調（RAFT）來提示或調整。在 ObliQA 上，這是一個基於阿布達比全球市場規則手冊建立的問答基準，分階段的檢索器將 Recall@10 從 0.256 提高到 0.774，並超越了 BM25（0.678）和 E5-large-v2（0.758），這是我們測試過的最強通用密集編碼器。RAFT-LoRA 隨後提高了我們能夠調整的每個模型的綜合 RePASs 答案質量分數，增幅在最弱的模型上最大。然而，調整後的模型無法轉移到澳大利亞案例法問題上，而一個完全不接收段落的閉卷模型的分數與完整管道的 RePASs 相差僅 0.011，同時產生的答案沒有引用任何內容並錯誤陳述義務。因此，檢索增益是直接測量的，生成增益是 RePASs 的增益而非證明的基礎，而基礎本身需要一個 RePASs 不提供的評估協議。
